capabilities.text: Type a formula with one central atom (main-group elements through period 5), including polyatomic ions like NO3- or SO4 2-
capabilities.note: Double-click handle also edits the formula inline.

capabilities.text: Type a single atom or monatomic ion (N, Ca 2+)
Pick a molecule with more than one central atom from a list (ethane, acetic acid, sulfuric acid...)
A flat textbook drawing, or shaped to hint at the real shape (bent H2O)
Bonds as lines or as pairs of dots
Formal charges shown on each atom whose formal charge is not 0
capabilities.note: Token passes on the formula alone; checked separately that formal=true changes the NO3- render (H2O has no non-zero formal charges).

capabilities.text: The octet rule or fewest formal charges (expanded octet) for ions like SO4 2-
capabilities.note: Token passes on the formula alone; checked separately that expand=true changes the SO4 2- render.

capabilities.text: One resonance structure, or all of them joined by double arrows
capabilities.note: Token passes on the formula alone; checked separately that Show all changes the NO3- render.

capabilities.text: Find-the-mistake: change a bond (none, single, double, triple) by clicking it
Find-the-mistake: change an atom's lone electrons by clicking it
Find-the-mistake: put the wrong atom in the centre

capabilities.note: Title style is None at the opening, so both are set; title alone renders the same.

capabilities.text: An answer key for a question or a changed structure
capabilities.note: Token passes on question alone; checked separately that answer=true changes the Skeleton render (as on the reference, the key needs a question or a change).
